_meta.note: Stable keys for Josh (TASK-007+). Do not rename keys mid-build; add new keys instead. Badge copy must stay aligned with packages/core/src/labels.ts (F-015 / §0.1).
_meta.tabLabelPolicy: Primary tab labels stay English product names (Home/Capture/Archive/Ask) in both locales; sentences and actions localize fully.

fixedTerms.note: Hindi pa alam stays Filipino in both fil and en modes (BR-014).

app.name: GUNITA
app.offlineBanner: You're offline. Try again when you have a signal.

common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.notAllowed: You don't have access to this.
common.errorBoundary: Something went wrong. Try again or go Home.

auth.signUpSubtitle: For families who want to keep their stories.
auth.inviteCodeHint: If your steward shared a code, enter it here.
auth.invalidInvite: That invite code is invalid or expired.
auth.sessionExpired: Your session expired. Please sign in again.

onboarding.spaceSubtitle: Who do you want to remember and keep stories for?
onboarding.featuredPersonHint: For example: Lola Rosa or Tito Ben
onboarding.uiLanguageHint: You can change this later in Settings.
onboarding.consentSubtitle: Before recording, we need their clear permission.
onboarding.consentAi: Allow AI to organize (transcript, extract, Ask)
onboarding.consentMemorial: Allow use on a memorial (if needed later)
onboarding.consentVoiceClips: Allow original voice clips on the memorial
onboarding.stewardAttestation: I am the steward; I confirm we have permission.
onboarding.waitingForConsent: Waiting for the steward to record consent.
onboarding.consentSaved: Consent saved. You can start capturing.

home.emptyBody: Start with Capture — one question, one story.

capture.hubSubtitle: Keep a story, photo, or memory.
capture.interviewHint: One question at a time. Large text, easy to read.
capture.keepOrDiscard: You have an unsent recording. Keep or discard it?
capture.artifactHint: A photo or PDF, plus what you already know about it.
capture.artifactContext: What do you know about this?
capture.artifactTooLarge: File is too large. Pick a smaller one.
capture.artifactTypeUnsupported: Unsupported file type. Photo or PDF only.
capture.memoryHint: This is About them — not From them.
capture.extractedEmpty: Nothing extracted yet. Wait for processing.
capture.micPermissionDenied: Microphone access is blocked. Allow the mic for this site in your browser settings, then reload.
capture.micPermissionDeniedVisitor: Microphone access is blocked. You can type or add a photo instead.
capture.recordingTooLarge: That recording is over the ~4 MB limit. Record a shorter answer, or split it into two.

questions.title: GUNITA Questions
questions.emptyBody: When new items are reviewed, new questions may appear here.

review.disputeNoteRequired: A note is required to dispute.
review.emptyBody: When you capture something new, AI suggestions show up here.
review.visibilityPrivateHint: Only you and the featured person (when applicable).
review.visibilityMemorialHint: May appear on the memorial if consent allows.
review.visibilityDisabledMemorial: Unavailable — consent did not allow memorial use.
review.visibilityCeiling: Cannot raise — the featured person set this to Private.
review.deleteSourceWarn: This deletes the source and every item from it, including recap cards.

archive.title: Archive
archive.subtitle: Every memory your family has reviewed, kept in one place.
archive.searchEmptyBody: Try different words. Search never invents an answer.

ask.title: Ask GUNITA
ask.abstainedBody: No reviewed source supports an answer yet. We will not invent one.
ask.partialNote: Only part is supported; the rest is Hindi pa alam.
ask.refusedBody: We won't speak as them or guess opinions they never shared. We only share what the family recorded.
ask.emptyIdle: Ask a question. We'll answer from the reviewed archive — or Hindi pa alam.
ask.citeHint: Open the source to listen or read.
ask.errorAsk: Couldn't get an answer. Try again.

family.title: Family & invites
family.inviteHint: Share in chat. It will expire.
family.emptyMembers: You're the only member so far.

settings.title: Settings
settings.withdrawWarn: New capture will stop. What was already recorded stays under the prior permission.

memorialSteward.title: Memorial Mode
memorialSteward.explain: When activated, you can build a public memorial for the lamay. Never automatic — it needs your clear action.
memorialSteward.reverseWarn: The reversal is recorded. The archive is not deleted.
memorialSteward.reversed: Reversed. The memorial is no longer public.
memorialSteward.selectEmpty: No Memorial-visible items yet. Change visibility in the Archive first.
memorialSteward.recapHint: Reorder, remove, or edit AI captions. Preview before you publish.
memorialSteward.recapEmpty: No cards yet. Go back and select items.
memorialSteward.previewHint: Phone-width preview; on a projector, center the column (~480px).
memorialSteward.qrHint: Print or share at the lamay. You can disable anytime.
memorialSteward.moderationHint: Visitor memories — approve or reject. You cannot edit their words.

memorialPublic.coverNoPhotoAlt: Soft paper gradient — no photo selected
memorialPublic.memoriesFromOthersEmpty: No approved memories from others yet.
memorialPublic.shareHint: The family will review before anything is shown.
memorialPublic.needOneOfThree: Add text, a photo, or a voice note.
memorialPublic.reviewNotice: The family will review your memory. It may appear as About them — never as something they said.
memorialPublic.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
memorialPublic.thanksBody: Received. The family will review it. Nothing else is needed.
memorialPublic.unavailableBody: This link is disabled, not yet published, or unknown.
memorialPublic.micPermissionDenied: Microphone access is blocked. You can type or add a photo instead.
